name: quioteframework/filesystem-azure
description: Azure Blob Storage filesystem adapter built on the AzureBlobClient from quioteframework/cloud-azure. Framework-agnostic: depends only on cloud-azure, so it is usable outside a Quiote application too. Quiote\Filesystem\Azure\AzureFilesystemAdapter/AzureFilesystemPlugin additionally implement Quiote's FilesystemAdapterInterface for FilesystemManager when quioteframework/quiote happens to be installed.

suggest.quioteframework/filesystem: Needed to use AzureFilesystemAdapter/AzureFilesystemPlugin as a Quiote\Filesystem\FilesystemManager disk; not needed to use AzureBlobClient/AzureBlobContainerClient from quioteframework/cloud-azure directly

extra.quiote-monorepo-note: Developed in-tree under quioteframework/quiote's packages/filesystem-azure/; split to this standalone repo via splitsh/lite on tag push. PRs go to the monorepo, not here.
